stage: G simplified midsurface-rim platen dynamic comparison to20pct; not finite-width contact or AD certification
lateral_macro: free ax/ay, zero macro shear; dynamics includes projected mass coupling
shell_contact: node-based cut rims against rigid planes; zero contact thickness by node-based pair definition; section thickness .5 retained
jax_contact: Occupied cap weights aggregated at nearest existing shell rim node; Q2 interpolation and force distribution at that point; reference area and kn conserved
remaining_difference: Same initial midsurface rim support locations; shell/solid kinematics, Q2 contact interpolation, penalty laws, diffuse occupancy and discrete inertia remain different.
interpretation: Forward dynamic comparison of a declared simplified end-loading model; not finite-width contact, self-contact, quasi-static or design-gradient certification.

execution_plan.requested_by_user: 2026-10-10: use midsurface-rim loading for a paired 20pct comparison; aim for <=90min total
execution_plan.amplitude: same quintic smooth-step in both solvers; from undeformed zero state
execution_plan.physical_time_scope: 4ms loading +0.2ms hold in each solver; same time is not same discrete timestep
execution_plan.budget_application: One sequential attempt per solver, Abaqus first. All numerical jobs count toward one total; a launch receives min(own cap, remaining total minus postprocessing reserve). No automatic retry or parameter change.

cost_basis.estimate_limit: No guarantee: distortion, timestep reduction and runtime checks can increase cost.

execution_plan.step_control: Start from the existing conservative estimate (about60ns), not a larger forced step. Retain rejection/reduction and actual-J guards; recheck current stability estimates at5/10/15/20pct when feasible within the same budget. No mass scaling.
execution_plan.loading_comparison_grid: 1001 evenly spaced engineering-compression samples from0 to.20, interpolate both full loading paths; no dynamic-time warping or curve scaling
execution_plan.primary_normalizer: maximum absolute Abaqus upper-platen reaction during this new full0-20pct loading path, fixed rule before solving; same denominator for global and window RMS
execution_plan.contextual_normalizer_purpose: Also tabulate RMS over the original2pct shell peak for traceability; not the full20pct acceptance denominator.
metrics: peak force and peak engineering compression (percentage-point difference)
force at2/5/10/15/20pct without near-zero relative ratios
loading work from force vs platen travel
last0.1ms hold mean upper/lower force separately
energy, impulse, actualJ and dt history
material end surface beyond platen and possible wall interpenetration as simplified-model limitations
execution_plan.working_target: About10pct for full-curve RMS, work and hold-mean relative bias, with segmented/peak/deformation evidence also disclosed; not an industry certificate or a guarantee. Incomplete paths cannot pass full20pct.
execution_plan.failure_policy: Save last valid state, achieved compression, time and stop reason. No force-discrepancy early stop, but stop for nonfinite response, nonpositive required actualJ, unresolvable timestep, timeout or solver error; never bypass protections to reach20pct.
execution_plan.implementation_needed_before_submission: Minimal new experiment driver reusing original build, PlatenXY and advance_block; original short runner has hardcoded2350s and full20=False, so it cannot simply be launched unchanged. Preserve all prior source bytes. Update new-case records honestly; no duplicate mechanics framework.
